name: AgentOS
tagline: One company brain for every AI tool your team uses.
description: AgentOS gives a team one shared company brain. Connect your tools and knowledge once, and every AI tool your team uses, like ChatGPT, Claude and your own agents, works from the same context. No more re-explaining your company in every new chat. Teams use it to run workflows, keep work in sync and get answers grounded in what the company actually knows.
